headline: Sen. Paul threatens to hold Fauci in contempt. And, a new rule undercuts U.S. asylum
context: Sen. Rand Paul is moving to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt of Congress after he invoked his Fifth Amendment rights. And, the Trump administration has announced a new rule for the asylum process.
